title: A Deep Learning Model System for Diagnosis and Management of Adnexal Masses
summary: A multistage deep-learning system classified ultrasound-detected adnexal masses and was evaluated against sonographers on internal and external hospital cohorts.
ai_technology: Methods describe evaluation and reader comparisons; Results report diagnostic performance across external test sets.
